ai.purpose: RTT structural map of the paper 'On the Paucity of Lattice Triangles'.
ai.module.summary: This module exposes the regime structure behind the density-zero result for obtuse rational lattice triangles, connecting geometric rank obstructions, modular arithmetic criteria, and Fourier-analytic cancellation. It preserves the authors' results while adding RTT operators for agentic reasoning.

geometric_rank_regime.description: Mirzakhani–Wright rank obstruction restricts which translation surfaces can be lattice surfaces.
geometric_rank_regime.evidence: Paper reformulates rank obstruction into modular arithmetic conditions.

modular_obstruction_regime.description: Larsen–Norton–Zykoski criterion reduces lattice property to inequalities involving residues modulo n.
modular_obstruction_regime.evidence: Proposition 2.1 gives modular inequalities ruling out lattice triangles.

fourier_ramanujan_regime.description: Counting function S(p,q) decomposed into main term and error term using Fourier analysis and Ramanujan sums.
fourier_ramanujan_regime.evidence: Section 3 develops Fourier expansion and Ramanujan-sum decomposition.

large_prime_factor_regime.description: Presence of a large prime factor in n forces strong cancellation in Ramanujan sums.
large_prime_factor_regime.evidence: Proposition 4.1 shows error suppression when P+(n) is large.

density_one_regime.description: Smooth-number theory implies denominators with large prime factors form a density-1 set.

formalization_regime.description: AxiomProver autoformalizes the analytic engine (Theorem 6.1) in Lean.

geometry_vs_arithmetic.description: Geometric rank obstruction vs modular arithmetic reformulation.
geometry_vs_arithmetic.paper_alignment: Section 2 transitions from geometry to arithmetic.

main_term_vs_error_term.description: Dominant main term vs oscillatory error term in S(p,q).

large_prime_vs_exceptional_set.description: Large prime factor yields cancellation; small exceptional residue classes remain.

analytic_vs_combinatorial_density.description: Analytic cancellation vs combinatorial counting in Hn.
analytic_vs_combinatorial_density.paper_alignment: Theorem 5.1 compares main term and error term.

modular_to_fourier_transition.description: Counting usable units becomes Fourier/Ramanujan analysis.

fourier_to_large_prime_transition.description: Ramanujan-sum vanishing controlled by large prime factors.

error_to_density_transition.description: Error suppression implies density-zero lattice triangles.

informal_to_lean_transition.description: AxiomProver converts natural-language proof into Lean code.

rank_obstruction_operator.role: Encodes Mirzakhani–Wright rank obstruction in modular form.

fourier_decomposition_operator.role: Splits S(p,q) into main term and error term.

ramanujan_cancellation_operator.role: Detects vanishing of Ramanujan sums based on prime-power structure.

density_operator.role: Evaluates density of admissible triangles in Hn.

formalization_operator.role: Maps informal proofs to Lean-verifiable structures.

ai.audience: Researchers in translation surfaces, Teichmüller dynamics, analytic number theory, and formal verification.
